title: The Collegians vaudeville group
summary: Norvo describes the new seven-piece Collegians, meeting a former trumpet player at the Ojai festival, and the group's jazz repertoire.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah, well -- well all right, let's go back to -- so you left college and you joined this group. Well what was the group?
Collegians, I think was the name of it.

I have pictures and I met -- funny I met the trumpet player up at the festival up at Ojai in California the trumpet player came by and showed me a picture. He said he'd been a newspaperman in California and he retired in Ojai there, Ojai festival there -- jazz festival. And, I was shocked, I forget his name, I think it was -- forgot what his name was now. He showed me a picture and I think his name was Wentworth, or something like that -- no that wasn't it -- we had a nickname for him --

-- I don't know what it was. He used to, I remember we were out West on that trip and he used to go with no hat, up in the Northwest, it was freezing and I could remember saying, why don't you wear a hat. He was on a
Were they a group that had been working together, the Collegians?
Yeah, no it was a new idea, new group.
And it was about seven pieces. I got a picture of it someplace, but it was a piano, I forget -- it was a piano, trumpet, drums, saxophone --
Yeah, I see and they were playing jazz?
